picks.commentary: Try the CLI; the oracle mention is a watch cue for protocol risk.
Steal this as a design heuristic for local tools.
picks.nugget_why: Prefer writable interfaces when designing local tooling. Clever caches hide state and make recovery harder; a writable boundary keeps the system inspectable, restartable, and easier to steal as a pattern across side projects. Treat it as a default when sketching CLIs and agent tools.
